bear_assumptions: USD 0.50 normalized forward EPS at 12x as component constraints, tariffs, promotions or weak discretionary demand reverse margin progress and working-capital cash conversion fades.
base_assumptions: USD 0.75 normalized forward EPS at 15x as full-year guidance converts after excluding the one-time tariff refund, peripherals and creator products offset component softness, improved gross margin persists, and dilution is broadly contained.
bull_assumptions: USD 1.00 normalized forward EPS at 18x as premium ecosystem growth broadens, Fanatec, Trak Racer and Elgato execution improves, component supply normalizes, and sustained mix and cost discipline lift cash earnings.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if the dependent full Q2 review normalizes the tariff refund, raised guidance, acquisition and working-capital effects into scenarios that clear expected-return, base-upside, payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if underlying margins revert, peripherals growth fails to offset component weakness, cash conversion reverses, Trak Racer destroys value, or dilution overwhelms per-share growth.
